study: Volatility-halt reopenings: does buying a momentum name at its LULD reopening (an auction: no spread paid on entry) and holding 5-30 minutes make money after the exit spread?
registered_at: 2026-10-03, before any halt data was fetched

data.candidates: name-days from the all-symbol daily panel (market_temperature study's fetch): common stock, open >= $1, (high - low) / prior close >= 15%, 2025-10-01..2026-10-02
data.bars: Alpaca SIP 1-minute RTH bars for each candidate name-day
data.quotes: Alpaca SIP NBBO at each exit time (historical, free once 15 min old)

definitions.halt: a run of >= 5 consecutive minutes with no 1-minute bar between 09:35 and 15:45, in a name that printed a bar in each of the 5 minutes before the gap (so a quiet name is not mistaken for a halt)
definitions.direction: UP halt: close of the last bar before the gap >= +5% vs the close 10 minutes earlier; DOWN halt: <= -5%; others discarded
definitions.entry: the open of the first bar after the gap (proxy for the reopening cross; no entry spread charged)
definitions.exits: close of the bar at +5, +15 and +30 minutes after the reopen bar, capped at 15:55; a later halt inside the hold exits at the last bar before it
definitions.cost: exit pays the SIP half-spread measured at the exit time (sell at the bid) plus a 10 bp slippage allowance; no entry cost
definitions.multiple_halts: every halt counts; reported also as first-halt-of-the-day only

split: events by date: first half / second half
statistic: mean net bp per event; t clustered by day (mean of daily means / its standard error)
pass: PRIMARY at +15 min: net >= +50 bp with day-clustered t >= 2 in BOTH halves and n >= 100 events per half. Also reported by price bucket ($1-5, $5-10, $10+), at +5 and +30 min, and gross.
if_pass: feasibility next, not a deploy: whether Alpaca orders entered during a halt participate in the reopening cross (unverified), then a paper test
caveats: halts are inferred from missing minutes, not from the official halt feed
the reopen bar's open is not guaranteed to equal the cross price
most halts are in sub-$10 names, below the desk's $10 floor
